findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:161 `theorem Module.finrank_prod [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Finite R M'] : finrank R (M × M') = finrank R M + finrank R M'` under `variable [Semiring R] ... [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Free R M']`. Mathlib states quotient finrank lemmas well below `DivisionRing` (e.g. `Submodule.finrank_quotient_le` at Constructions.lean:102, `Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank` at RankNullity.lean:247).
findings.fix: State it as `variable [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Free R (M ⧸ p)] [Module.Free R (N ⧸ q)] [Module.Finite R (M ⧸ p)] [Module.Finite R (N ⧸ q)]`, keeping the body `rw [(quotientProdEquiv p q).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod]`. Division-ring call sites (`Analysis/Fredholm/Prod.lean:90`) are unaffected, since `StrongRankCondition` and `Module.Free` are instances there.
findings.issue: `finrank_quotient_prod` assumes `[DivisionRing R]`, stronger than the `Module.finrank_prod` it is proved from, which is stated at `[Semiring R] [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Free _] [Module.Finite _]` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:161, variables at :109 and :143). `LinearEquiv.finrank_eq` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Finrank.lean:116) adds nothing. This excludes ℤ-modules — the scalar ring of the other consumer this PR touches, `IntegralLattice/Discriminant/Operations.lean`.

summary: The two equivalences sit at the right level, but `finrank_quotient_prod` is stated over a `DivisionRing` when the identical one-line proof gives the Mathlib-level free-and-finite statement over any ring.
